        },
        new Recipe

            Ingredients = "Butter
Sugar
Brown sugar
Eggs
Vanilla

Baking soda
Salt
Chocolate chips",
            Steps = "1. Cream butter and sugars until fluffy.

        },
        new Recipe

Espresso
Mascarpone

Heavy cream
Cocoa powder
Kahlúa (optional)",

        }

    public void AddRating(int recipeId, int stars)

        var recipe = GetById(recipeId);
        if (recipe is not null && stars >= 1 && stars <= 5)
        {
            recipe.Ratings.Add(stars);
        }
    }

    public void AddRecipe(string title, string category, string ingredients, string steps)

        _recipes.Add(new Recipe
        {
            Id = _nextId++,
            Title = title,
            Category = category,
            Ingredients = ingredients,
            Steps = steps
        });
    }

- `Pages/Category.razor` — Lists recipes in a category (static SSR)

- `Pages/SubmitRecipe.razor` — Interactive form with validation (title, category, ingredients, steps)
